=== .github/workflows/release.yml (hosted-workflows)
# Imported from .github/workflows/release.yml by launchway import pipeline. The old files are untouched.
# Read the findings it printed: lines marked NEEDS A PERSON below are not converted.
# Dry import: steps that deliver are off. Set the input enable_delivery default to true to turn them all on.
pipeline: release
on:
  push: {tags: [v*]}
inputs:
  enable_delivery:
    type: boolean
    default: false
    description: Turn on the steps that deliver (push an image, release, deploy). Off while you compare this pipeline with the old one.
steps:
  image:
    kind: image
    file: build/Dockerfile
    target: runtime
    platforms: [linux/amd64, linux/arm64]
    build_args:
      VERSION: 1.2.3
      COMMIT: {run: sha}
    push: false
  image-push:
    kind: image
    file: build/Dockerfile
    target: runtime
    platforms: [linux/amd64, linux/arm64]
    build_args:
      VERSION: 1.2.3
      COMMIT: {run: sha}
    push: true
    tags:
      - {repository: team/shop, tag: {run: sha}}
      - {repository: team/shop, tag: latest}
    needs: image
    when: {input: enable_delivery}
  deploy:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: image-push
    when: {input: enable_delivery}
    secrets:
      KUBE_TOKEN: {store: vault, key: KUBE_TOKEN, field: value}
    run: |
      # Roll out
      (
        export KUBE_TOKEN="${KUBE_TOKEN}"
        kubectl set image deployment/shop shop=registry.example.test/team/shop:${LAUNCHWAY_COMMIT}
      )
      echo "$LAUNCHWAY_COMMIT on $LAUNCHWAY_BRANCH"
  publish:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: image-push
    when: {input: enable_delivery}
    run: |
      (
        export TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
        npm publish
      )
